sources: ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 630120, captured 2026-10-12 (audit/state_park_fees/mt_sites_2026-10-12.json)

values.note: 25 tent and RV sites (7 of them walk-in) plus a hike/bike site; only site 009 has electric. Pull-throughs: sites 002 and 006.

sites.source: https://fwp.mt.gov/stateparks/whitefish-lake ('There are 25 campsites which offer a variety of tent only and RV camping opportunities, plus a new hike-bike campsite'; 'RV/trailer size limit is 40 feet in length') + ReserveAmerica site list (23 Campsite, 1 Campsite Electric (009), 1 hike-bike; 002 '48 Pull-Through', 006 '25 Pull-Through'; 016-021 walk-in), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://montanastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/whitefish-lake-state-park/r/campsiteDetails.do?siteId=684&contractCode=MT&parkId=630120 (site 009 'Campsite Electric', 'Electricity Hookup: 50', 'Max Vehicle Length: 32', 'Driveway Length: 37'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Water and showers close in early October and reopen late April/early May. Boat launch; Tour Glacier rents kayaks, paddleboards and pedal boats June 15 - Labor Day.

facilities.source: https://fwp.mt.gov/stateparks/whitefish-lake (Amenities: 'Boat Launch', 'Boat Rental', 'Shower', 'Toilets (Flush)', 'Water'; 'Water and showers: Closes Oct. 5, 2025. Everything will reopen in late April/early May.'), read 2026-10-22

booking.source: https://fwp.mt.gov/stateparks/whitefish-lake ('Reserve a Campsite'; 'Reservation Phone Number: 1-855-922-6768') + https://montanastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/whitefish-lake-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MT&parkId=630120 (Campsite and Campsite Electric: 'Reservations must be made 1 Day(s) ahead of arrival and can be made up to 3 Month(s) in advance.'; Hike-Bike: 2 days), read 2026-10-22

note: MT FWP state park on the south shore of Whitefish Lake, just outside Whitefish: a mature-woodland campground with a beach. Trains regularly pass and stop beside the campground. --Claude
summary: FWP + ReserveAmerica: confirmed 25 sites, 40-ft limit, flush toilets/showers/water, reservable on ReserveAmerica (90-day window and 1-day cutoff now verified for this park). Added 50-amp electric (one site, 009), pull-throughs (002, 006), seasonal water/shower note. Fees (FWP schedule, human) and season (manual) left; FWP says only 'Campsite fees range from $4-$34'. Note: sites/facilities/reservable/season restatements dropped, train caveat added.
